source_branch: main at audit/revalidated handoff observation; not released-behavior proof
implementation_status: Design and tasks only. No repository edits, tests or remote mutations executed for this handoff.

integration_contract.branch: Separate program integration branch chosen by receiving agent; keep away from main until whole program complete and tested.
integration_contract.release: Final major release after full-program migration, exact-artifact qualification and publication/recovery gates; no new version selected here.
user_decisions: Functional scoped Pi child authorship must be implemented; read-only is transitional degradation only.
Conflicts affect dependent work only, except genuine shared authority loss.
Corrected debug/reviewer resubmission is permitted after fresh validation.
Durable interruption recovery must not block unrelated ordinary progress.
SMARTS progress/evidence semantics are deferred to B and receiving agent.
Include ADR proposals without treating accepted ADRs as implementation/release evidence.

minimum_pi_profile.name: proposed host-trusted exact-operation delegation
minimum_pi_profile.guarantee: Parent admits exact tool/action/command requests and owns execution, consent, durable outcome and revocation under existing host trust.
minimum_pi_profile.non_guarantee: No transitive OS filesystem or network confinement for arbitrary shell/test code.
minimum_pi_profile.stronger_profile: If advertised, must use a separately qualified backend with no silent weaker fallback. No universal Docker dependency is required for the minimum profile.
minimum_pi_profile.api_boundary: New internal Arbiter protocol; local ExtensionAPI structural declarations expose no upstream delegation API.

tasks.title: Freeze the parent delegation, effect observation and trust-profile contracts

external_dependencies.use: Register and validate a closed namespace only if storage uses the reserved artifact root; otherwise retain agreed host bookkeeping owner.

tasks.behavior_change: Add a versioned internal parent-issued run grant plus per-operation admission and outcome contract. The minimum profile is exact tool/action/command admission under existing host trust, with no implied OS filesystem or network confinement.
implementation_steps: Record an ADR proposal with the user-selected functional author acceptance criterion and the explicit trusted-host versus confined execution profiles.

Define bounded closed grant, operation, response, record and fd3-envelope decoders; parent-generated caller/run/child/generation bindings; role ceiling; exact request digest; expiry and revocation; resource-precondition and observation fields.
Separate admission, execution, observation, containment and recovery dimensions; keep model judgment distinct from parent-observed effects.
Specify strict repository/worktree identity and admitted direct request targets; do not use canonicalPath lexical fallback as proof of strict target authority.

Choose one agreed host bookkeeping owner and agree NT-10 record/file-effect limits. Git-common bookkeeping may remain outside the artifact store; register a closed namespace with NT-02 only if using the reserved artifact root. Do not assume current CAS APIs can execute arbitrary source files.
Preserve callers omitting optional scope proposals: proposals are untrusted requests, never tokens or executable paths. No hidden grant derived from task prose.
Define initial exact-operation consent; finite preapproved batches are an optional later optimization and cannot become wildcard commands.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Existing one author maximum per dispatch, role catalog tool ceilings, depth/concurrency/output limits, no recursive orchestration, child untrusted-project setting, and separate internal compaction with no tools.
Current plan-mode planning-write exception remains separately bounded; a child does not acquire it merely by choosing a path.
No universal Docker/sandbox dependency for ordinary delegation.

acceptance: Contract tests admit a legitimate author grant proposal after parent narrowing and retain legacy reviewer dispatch shape.
All operation outcomes round-trip without collapsing unknown into failure/no-effect or containment into exit code.
Every public claim names its execution profile and evidence level.
rejection_and_failure: Unknown fields, version, tool/action class, oversized record, invalid target, duplicate identity with changed digest, and model-supplied authority fields are rejected.
Read-only or handshake-only author behavior cannot satisfy the completion contract.
concurrency_and_interruption: Two grants bind distinct parent run/generation identities even when role/task text matches.
Grant lifetime cannot increase after wall-clock changes or parent restart.

completion_evidence: Reviewed contract/ADR diff with exact existing versus proposed APIs and a machine-readable decoder fixture set.
Native/hook/root owners agree namespace, recovery notification seam and no cycle in implementation dependencies.
rollback: Before release, revert contract consumers together or leave the new author capability disabled; do not parse a new format with old permissive decoders.
Retain unknown-version records read-only and do not resurrect old authority.
claim_delta: Parent delegation remains planned until implementation and exact-artifact qualification.
Exact operation admission does not imply arbitrary command confinement.
adr_actions: Propose scoped Pi parent delegation ADR; amend only conflicting child/permission passages while retaining isolation and final-argument requirements.

tasks.title: Plumb parent authority and reuse the final operation permission gate
tasks.behavior_change: Make child effects cross the same final-argument bridge, descriptor policy, live trust, mode, source ownership and parent consent boundary as parent operations.
implementation_steps: Pass parent current mode, immutable caller correlation, lifecycle authorization, trusted cwd, registry/source identity and parent UI context through an internal dispatch admission port.

Extract/reuse the existing gate sequence rather than copying a weaker child policy. Freeze final parameters; call bridge; preserve hard-block versus advisory-warning distinctions; evaluate policy; confirm exact operation when required.
Use the actual host tool-call ID for parent correlation instead of ignoring it. Keep random activity IDs informational.
Recheck trust, generation, mode, raw/canonical parameters, registry ownership, original executor identity, target observations and abort after every relevant await.
Record consent source honestly: parent human confirmation, admitted finite batch or policy allow. Configuration handshake attestation never supplies consent.
Keep headless authors unavailable unless a concrete supported explicit host-authority route is separately implemented; do not forge TUI context or mutate project trust.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Bootstrap/final source guard; current hard rules; plan source/config/shell denies; read/inspection behavior and bounded native plan-write exception.
Existing direct parent operations retain permission behavior and final argument binding.
Permission refusal does not permanently bar corrected debug/reviewer submissions.

acceptance: Parent TUI approval of a frozen admitted write/edit/command reaches exactly one effect executor.
Bridge warning remains advisory through permission; hard block bypasses UI and execution.
Legacy parent tool tests and installed-host final-argument ordering cells remain green with their evidence substitutions stated.
rejection_and_failure: Missing/throwing trust, plan mode, no UI, declined/timed-out UI, foreign wrapper, unsupported descriptor, changed command/args, changed native function and audit admission failure execute nothing.
An ambient child marker or successful handshake cannot bypass permission.
concurrency_and_interruption: Mutate arguments, mode, trust, owner, executor and lifecycle during bridge/UI/journal awaits; stale operations never execute.
A valid new lifecycle remains operational after an old approval becomes stale.

completion_evidence: Exact test output showing no direct-parent regression and final-argument identity before real effect invocation.
Review of the dispatch registration path demonstrates mode/authority are actually plumbed, not inferred from task text.
rollback: Disable new delegated admission and revoke live grants before reverting; retain existing parent gate unchanged.
Preserve denied/unknown operation records for later inspection.
claim_delta: Parent source ownership is a prerequisite, not proof of task permission.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated child proxies and parent-owned effect execution
tasks.behavior_change: Child write/edit/bash tools become explicit bounded proxies to a parent-owned executor; successful admission no longer depends on a child TUI or child self-grant.
implementation_steps: Create a purpose-separated local operation transport with per-child token and parent registry binding; do not reuse inference-broker tokens or general RPC confirmation messages.

Replace the 32-byte-only fd3 format with the agreed bounded versioned envelope for matching new bundles; keep strict old/new refusal and one-shot nonce semantics. Test raw Windows fd3 forwarding without repurposing supervisor fd4–fd7.
Keep the existing child final guard and source owner, but route the delegated branch to proxy execution instead of local mutation factories.
Parent executes admitted effects, owns deadlines/output limits/managed process trees, and returns observed results. A boolean approval followed by child-local mutation is not sufficient.

For shell execution verify the exact supported Pi options before use. Do not invent an environment option on the generic createBashToolDefinition record. Reuse/extract internal piShellLaunch/process-tree behavior or an owned helper with qualified tool-result adaptation.
Use a bounded credential-blind command environment/private home and operator setting projection; never inherit full parent process.env or expose inference/operation tokens to project commands.
Keep inference endpoint/credential authority separate, close/revoke both channels on child retirement, and choose one owner for correlated post-write bridge effects.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Exact Node/Pi/package/charter/skills launch validation; no project extension/context loading; private environment; broker-supported provider restrictions; no recursive dispatch/farm in child.
Existing shell prefix/platform behavior must be preserved or explicitly rejected with a bounded diagnostic, never silently ignored.
No promise of transitive filesystem or network confinement in the trusted-host profile.

acceptance: A packaged child sends a real write/edit/command request through the channel; parent performs it and child receives the corresponding bounded tool result.
Local transport and process supervision work on every declared supported OS/architecture; token is absent from logs, prompts and subprocess environments.
Read-only reviewers and compaction retain their separate capabilities.
rejection_and_failure: Wrong child/run/token/purpose/version, nonlocal peer, invalid method/content type, oversize frame, excessive concurrent requests, malformed fd3, replayed bootstrap and unexpected RPC UI request execute nothing.
Unsupported upstream runtime or unavailable executor yields explicit degraded authorship, not unguarded native fallback.
Tests attempt to read known sentinel provider credentials/tokens through command environment and final output; no leak is accepted.
concurrency_and_interruption: Child dies during bootstrap, request, result, or cleanup; parent revokes and closes listeners while preserving owned settlement.
Cancellation during Windows containment readiness never delivers mutation capability before readiness.
Parent/child mixed-version bundles fail before task effects.

completion_evidence: Source and built-bundle protocol tests, exact managed process traces and credential-negative fixtures.
Artifact receipts distinguish fake provider/bridge pieces from real host/real executor routes.
rollback: Revoke channel tokens, deny new requests, settle owned processes and retain effect journals before disabling the feature.
Old bundles must not adopt new records or bootstrap envelopes permissively.
claim_delta: New delegation channel is an internal Arbiter protocol, not an upstream Pi API.
Host-trusted exact commands can run project code and use host resources under that profile.

tasks.title: Add exclusive effect claims, durable outcomes and read-only reconciliation

external_dependencies.use: Bounded host delegation record/file-effect seam after PI-D01; current store is not a source executor.
Namespace registration only if journal uses artifact reserved root; separate host bookkeeping otherwise.
Shared notice consumes PI-D04 observations and PI-D05 revocation. Agree observation shape now; HW-14 implementation depends on Pi, not the reverse.
Shared durable recovery ownership/storage conventions, no mandatory artifact journal.
Selected-owner read-only reconciliation; preserve resource scope and no grant restoration.

tasks.behavior_change: Persist operation identity before delegated mutations, deduplicate identical requests, retain uncertain outcomes and recover observations without replaying effects or restoring authority.
implementation_steps: Implement bounded versioned records under one agreed host bookkeeping owner with exact owner/repository/worktree identity and exclusive operation IDs. Register with NT-02 only if using the artifact reserved root; do not require that root or a universal host-effect pending guard.
Use state transitions proposed→admitted→claimed→executing→observed/unknown; persist claim before execution and observed outcome before successful response.
Do not treat appendAuditLine false as proof no row exists: it can fail after append/sync. Operation journal writes need explicit durable/unknown semantics.
Same ID+digest returns or joins the stored outcome; same ID+different digest rejects. No second executor is created merely because a response or receipt is missing.
Track direct-file pre/post observations and command/process references separately. Desired bytes observed after a crash do not prove causal exactly-once execution; never roll back over user edits.
Implement bounded read-only reconciliation and shared startup/reentry notification. A restart retires grants; records cannot mint new live tokens.
Read-only/ordinary progress does not require closing every historical recovery item. Only dependent effects wait for relevant unresolved resources.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Existing permission audit failure policy; redaction; host state path ownership; unrelated workflow progress.
Native artifact journal/CAS is not automatically an arbitrary source-file executor. NT-10 may choose host-specific bounded storage.
No automatic replay for arbitrary shell or external effects.
If a shared store is chosen, its real pending-journal integrity dependency remains until reconciled; this does not turn semantic task/delegation conflicts into a global stop.

acceptance: Exactly one persisted claim and one executor under duplicate requests; stable stored response after response loss.
Fresh parent reports recoverable old observations and issues one bounded notice without recreating authority.
A disjoint ordinary edit can proceed while an unrelated old effect remains unresolved.
rejection_and_failure: Linked/junction/hardlinked/foreign-owner journal, corrupt/unknown version, quota overflow, failed durable claim, identity drift and changed request digest do not start new effects.
A source hash matching intended output after a crash is reported as observed state unless causal completion was independently recorded.
concurrency_and_interruption: Crash/fault before claim, after claim, before/after effect, before/after outcome write, before response and during restart.
Concurrent duplicate and differing operations; user edits during recovery; process cleanup unknown; audit bytes written then return false.
Journal lock/version contention is scoped and bounded, with no global ordinary-work deadlock.

completion_evidence: Crash matrix with recorded operation transitions, call counts, resource observations and replay refusal.
Storage confinement/platform tests for any new primitive and explicit evidence boundaries for non-atomic native file tools.
Hook owner confirms recovery notice consumes observations only.
rollback: Retain journals and user files; revoke grants; use read-only downgrade reader or refuse unknown schema with actionable inspection.
Do not delete records to make rollback appear clean and do not compensate arbitrary commands automatically.
claim_delta: Separate observed effect from model judgment and from desired-state coincidence.
adr_actions: Propose durable effect observation/recovery decision with dependent-resource conflict scope.

tasks.title: Complete revocation, expiry, concurrency and settlement ownership
tasks.behavior_change: Retire authority immediately on lifecycle changes while preserving cleanup/reconciliation, and confine conflicts to dependent resources.
implementation_steps: Connect explicit task cancel, timeout, trust withdrawal, plan-mode transition, session switch/fork/reload/unload/shutdown and child close to grant retirement.
Use a separate settling owner for cleanup and read-only observation so generation invalidation does not abandon owned processes/resources.
Bound operation queue/concurrency and sequence numbers; retain one author maximum per dispatch. Serialize overlapping owned source effects and reject changed preconditions.
Require new admission for corrected operations after refusal; permit legitimate corrected debug/reviewer resubmission rather than permanent stale bans.
Keep global authority loss distinct from dependent-work conflict. Unknown unbounded shell effects need honest resource-scope limitations.
Make late rendering/activity failures informational and unable to grant, revoke or falsely complete operations.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Current cancellation limits and platform containment; native planning exception; same-generation direct parent behavior.
Unrelated tasks/read operations stay available for scoped conflicts.
Trust withdrawal still retires project-lifecycle mutation authority.

acceptance: Task-specific cancel retires only its grant and settles its owned work.
New valid lifecycle works while old token and pending approval remain unusable.
Corrected request with new ID and current authority can proceed after a prior refusal.
rejection_and_failure: Expired/revoked/sibling/stale-generation operations never execute, including after fresh reactivation.
Source owner/executable settings drift cannot spend prior consent.
concurrency_and_interruption: Race mode/trust/session transition at each async boundary; old approval versus new session; late child response versus retirement.
Two calls on same resource serialize or conflict; identical calls deduplicate; disjoint reads continue.
Cancellation/output overflow with surviving descendant reports containment unverified and holds only affected dependencies.

completion_evidence: Race/fault suite on supported platforms with independent admission and settlement assertions.
No orphan process/token/listener in retirement matrix; retained unknown records when proof is unavailable.
rollback: Disable new admissions, drain/observe existing ownership and preserve unresolved records before reverting lifecycle wiring.
Never make cleanup disappear by applying stale-UI suppression to it.

tasks.title: Project truthful delegation capability and evidence diagnostics
tasks.behavior_change: Expose admitted/available/qualified/degraded author capability, recovery scope and evidence mode without claiming handshake or optional artifact approval proves authorship.
implementation_steps: Generate or derive capability facts from actual runtime/permission contracts; distinguish reviewer read, author write/edit/command, optional artifact prompt and stronger isolation profiles.
Show fixed bounded reason codes for no parent UI, revoked grant, executor unavailable, journal unknown and unverified cleanup; preserve human detail privately where appropriate.
Keep current child judgment separately visible from parent effect/containment/recovery state.
Propagate one owning capability fact into help, doctor, role/host notes and public claims; handwritten adapters remain handwritten where appropriate.
Read-only fallback is marked transient degraded author capability and cannot satisfy the program completion check.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: No secret-bearing prompts/paths/credentials in general audit output; no new routine attestation ceremony.
Host-specific capability differences and supported-runtime boundaries.

acceptance: Diagnostic fixture matrix yields distinct and accurate capability/evidence states.
A mutating fixture produces parent-observed effects and current qualified package identity in its receipt.
rejection_and_failure: Handshake-only, fake accepted child, synthetic artifact policy event and source-only probe cannot set author-qualified or released flags.
Degraded state cannot be cleared by unrelated bridge success if required author capability remains unavailable.
concurrency_and_interruption: Late old-run activity/status cannot overwrite a new lifecycle capability or pending recovery observation.

completion_evidence: Claim matrix linked to owning contracts and exact evidence records, with source/planned/qualified/released distinctions.
UX review of parent confirmation and recovery notice with no implementation jargon in ordinary flow.
rollback: Restore previous honest capability labels while retaining records; never retain a qualified label after disabling the executor.
claim_delta: Capability-specific matrix replaces broad Pi supported/unsupported claims.

tasks.title: Qualify real packaged author behavior and regressions on supported hosts

external_dependencies.use: Full behavior/migration/installed-artifact matrix.
Exact-candidate major-release readiness.
Publish identical qualified bytes and verify distributions.

tasks.behavior_change: Make functional parent-mediated child write/edit/command and negative/recovery evidence against exact packaged bytes a major-release gate.
implementation_steps: Build matching parent/child/helper bundles and candidate package only on the isolated integration branch; record complete loaded closure and artifact digests.
Install the exact candidate into disposable homes and use the actual admitted Pi runtime/extension loader/tool loop, real file effects and managed command execution.
Drive a write, edit and command fixture through real child proxies and parent confirmation; include visible parent TUI confirmation evidence, not only an injected true callback.
Retain installed-host final-argument fixture while labeling substituted bridge/factories; deterministic local provider is acceptable when declared and sufficient for the local effect claim.
Execute rejection/replay/interruption/race/platform matrix from the design. Add update/disable/uninstall and mixed-bundle refusal cells.
Only call functional authorship qualified when required cells pass for exact bytes. Publication must use identical bytes or requalify rebuilt artifacts.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: No real secret disclosure, user repo mutation, paid provider requirement or inferred release from main.
Existing platform/runtime support decisions remain explicit; qualify each claimed cell rather than assume every version above a floor.

acceptance: Actual resulting file bytes and command result match approved frozen requests; one executor per operation.
Reviewer chain can inspect effects; no-change task reports honest no-change outcome.
Exact artifact install/update/disable/uninstall succeeds under supported-host contracts.
rejection_and_failure: A source module probe, fake runner success, handshake-only flow or permanently read-only author causes the new gate to fail.
Package digest/runtime mismatch, stale qualification or unsupported executor profile prevents qualification.
concurrency_and_interruption: Run full kill-point and concurrency cases on POSIX and Windows where supported, including actual supervisor fd3 forwarding.
A killed parent cannot leave a usable token or silently replay an unknown effect on next startup.

completion_evidence: Machine-readable exact-artifact receipts: package/bundle SHA-256, Pi identity, Node/Python, OS/architecture, policy/executor profile, test route, substitutions, outcomes and limitations.
Complete program gate reviewed before main integration and major publication.
rollback: Keep feature degraded and program unreleased if any required cell fails; preserve evidence and fix the specific failing contract.
Distribution rollback points to last qualified artifact and retains recoverable records.
claim_delta: Source admission of Pi 1.1.0/Node >=22.19.0/Python 3 is not all-platform qualification.

tasks.title: Make persona readiness an independent prerequisite and retryable state
tasks.behavior_change: Prevent a ready/governed state from surviving missing persona content or being healed merely by unrelated bridge success.
implementation_steps: Represent persona and bridge readiness independently with explicit load failure/retry transitions.
Choose the narrowest truthful readiness prerequisite: load required persona before full governed readiness, or expose a distinct unavailable capability that cannot appear fully ready.
A retry reloads persona content for the current generation; bridge refresh may clear only bridge degradation.
Use the same prerequisite vector for prompt construction, dispatch admission and status.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Dormant/untrusted host behavior, existing safe bootstrap guard and current persona ordering/content semantics.
Failure diagnostics remain bounded and do not accidentally make optional display work a governance prerequisite.

acceptance: Persona failure followed by success of bridge alone remains persona-unavailable.
Explicit successful persona retry in current lifecycle produces correct prompt and readiness once.
rejection_and_failure: Empty/missing/failed persona cannot mark full author readiness; late old persona cannot populate new session.
concurrency_and_interruption: Session transition during persona read; retry races with bridge refresh; shutdown during load.

completion_evidence: Activation tests asserting both authority readiness and actual prompt content after fault/retry.
Source path and generated bundle evidence match.
rollback: Revoke current generation and restore prior complete adapter if needed; never roll back to a status that hides missing persona.

tasks.title: Cancel pending sidebar installation across disposal
tasks.behavior_change: A disposed sidebar cannot acquire terminal width or renderer hooks when an earlier asynchronous metrics request finishes.
implementation_steps: Reuse the footer generation/lease pattern for every sidebar install await and final compositor patch.
Dispose invalidates pending installs and restores only hooks owned by that connection/generation.
Keep late UI completion suppression separate from execution/resource cleanup ownership.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Native rendering fallback, runtime support probe, existing sidebar geometry rules and fail-soft display behavior.

acceptance: Dispose-while-metrics-pending then resolve leaves installed=false, original columns and renderer unchanged.
A new valid session can install once after old install is invalidated.
rejection_and_failure: Probe or metrics failure cannot leave half-installed hooks or falsely claim unavailable native rendering.
concurrency_and_interruption: Old and new metrics promises resolve in both orders; repeated dispose; geometry change during install.

completion_evidence: Regression of audit-work/probe-pi-sidebar-dispose.mjs promoted into maintained behavior test.
Supported live sidebar test where that private runtime hook is claimed.
rollback: Disable sidebar capability and return native rendering; do not retain stale compositor hooks.

tasks.title: Unify supported native release-manifest shape across consumers

external_dependencies.use: Consumes DIST-M01 for Python optional context_qualification compatibility; original audit finding HOOK-B05.
Exact package qualification/evidence semantics.

tasks.behavior_change: Farm accepts and validates the supported context_qualification extension on production-qualified manifests without weakening binary identity and confinement checks.
implementation_steps: Define one versioned manifest contract and derive/conformance-test parsers across TS/Python packaging, installation and verification.
Preserve exact required fields and supported optional-field validation; reject unknown versions/fields and malformed optional values according to the chosen schema.
Keep binary digests, platform entry, protocol/schema compatibility and path ownership checks; accepting a sixth field is not a reason to skip validation.
Create a final qualified package fixture with context_qualification and pass it through installed farm binary admission, not only candidate five-key construction.
Coordinate HOOK-B05 and hosted publish verifier parsing so source/enriched manifest phases remain distinct.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Five-key candidate manifests where valid; richer qualified production phase; exact artifact provenance and host differences.

acceptance: Both valid candidate and qualified production shapes parse at their intended phases; final installed qualified package reaches the pinned engine.
rejection_and_failure: Unknown field/version, malformed context entry, wrong platform/hash/path/protocol and stale qualification fail with precise stage reasons.
concurrency_and_interruption: No shared mutable parser state; package replacement between observation and execution is detected by existing identity protections.

completion_evidence: Cross-language schema fixtures plus exact qualified-artifact farm admission receipt.
No claim that an already published package failed unless its exact bytes were tested.
rollback: Revert readers and producer schema together or keep old-format packaging on integration; never drop qualification metadata just to pass farm.
Retain old artifacts unchanged.
claim_delta: Candidate versus qualified manifest is a versioned contract, not two unrelated key-set guesses.

tasks.title: Separate farm effect recovery from receipt repair and author retry

external_dependencies.use: Selected-owner outcome reconciliation.
Register durable harvest obligations at producer discovery.
Reporting-only farm diagnostics must not invent circuit-breaker cause or premium dispatch.

tasks.behavior_change: A final report failure preserves completed commits/merges and offers read-only reconciliation/receipt repair; a new run cannot silently truncate or replace old run evidence.
implementation_steps: Create run IDs exclusively; reject existing FARM_RUN_ID unless an explicit verified recovery mode is selected. Avoid recursive existing-directory adoption and stream truncation.
Persist bounded task/worktree/branch/base/integration commit and tree identities around owned effects; distinguish author outcome, merge outcome, cleanup and report publication.
Add recover-receipt path that re-observes refs and reconstructs only supportable reporting without scheduling authors, resetting integration or replacing task branches.
Require explicit new attempt identity and resource preconditions for author retry. Unknown branch observations remain unknown.
Correct installed farm guidance and diagnostic tools so report exit 3 does not instruct immediate redispatch or mislabel every abort as circuit breaker/premium reroute.
Scope conflict holds to dependent task/branch/integration resources; retain independent work.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Existing branch/worktree containment, task/quality/mutation outcomes and anti-gaming heuristic evidence limits.
A green task result is not a published-report receipt; a missing report is not evidence effects never happened.

acceptance: Inject report failure after successful commits/merge and recover truthful receipt without invoking author or resetting refs.
Fresh run ID creates new evidence; existing run ID rejects without truncation.
rejection_and_failure: Changed/missing/unreadable refs, reused identity, incompatible record schema or unverified cleanup cannot produce a false recovered-green receipt.
No recovery automatically force-resets a user/other-task branch.
concurrency_and_interruption: Crash before/after commit/merge/report write; concurrent recoverers; same run ID race; branch advances between observation and action.
Dependent tasks pause while independent task evidence remains usable.

completion_evidence: Real disposable Git integration tests with before/after ref digests, author call counts and preserved logs.
Updated agent instructions explicitly separate recover, inspect and new attempt.
rollback: Keep new records and refs; disable mutating recovery mode if needed, retaining read-only diagnostics.
Do not roll back by deleting successful commits or rewriting old reports as never executed.
claim_delta: Receipt repair is distinct from author redispatch; aborted cause and premium routing must be observed.
adr_actions: Durable effect observation/recovery ADR covers farm-specific refs and report ownership.

tasks.title: Preserve containment outcomes through quality gate retries
tasks.behavior_change: A quality gate whose prior process tree is not verified stopped cannot be treated as an ordinary retryable test failure.
implementation_steps: Return typed command outcome, interrupt reason and containment result from exec through runGate/runTask and reporting.
Reuse the mutation path policy that treats cleanupFailed as unsafe for subsequent reset/retry; preserve code 124 versus 125 information while migrating consumers.
Stop admission to affected worktree mutations until owned cleanup/re-observation verifies containment; retain reason and process references.
Use cancellation-independent bounded cleanup, and do not fabricate an output-overflow behavior that current farm exec does not implement.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Verified-clean timeout can follow the documented retry policy; ordinary nonzero quality failures remain distinct.
Scope holds to affected task/worktree/integration dependencies, not a blanket unrelated-project stop.

acceptance: Gate timeout with verified cleanup can proceed according to policy; cleanupFailed reaches runTask and prevents reset/author retry.
After observed cleanup, explicit policy retry obtains a new attempt identity.
rejection_and_failure: Unverified descendants, cleanup helper refusal and unknown state cannot become an ordinary gate failure or clean timeout.
concurrency_and_interruption: A descendant writes after parent exit; verify retry/reset never races it.
Cancellation during cleanup keeps cleanup ownership live; parallel unrelated task can finish.

completion_evidence: Maintained executor and farm integration tests asserting actual retry/reset call counts and process observations.
Typed report fields carry containment independently from gate status.
rollback: Fail the affected task safely with retained process/ref evidence if new typed route must be disabled; never revert to blind retry.

tasks.title: Treat failed Git observations as unknown drift state
tasks.behavior_change: Git diff/ls-files failure cannot produce an observed-clean drift result.
implementation_steps: Use observed-clean, observed-dirty and unavailable results with command/diagnostic codes bounded and redacted.
Allow bounded read-only observation retries for transient failures; preserve unknown after exhaustion.
Require relevant clean observation before dependent commits/merges/reset decisions, without asserting no changes when the probe failed.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Existing legitimate clean/dirty path calculations and protected-path checks.
Unrelated task progress remains available.

acceptance: Successful empty observations are clean; successful paths are dirty; failed observations are unavailable.
rejection_and_failure: Either or both Git probes fail, malformed output, timeout and revoked process access cannot be treated as empty path arrays.
concurrency_and_interruption: Working tree changes between observations; final dependent action uses a current precondition.
Retry cancellation leaves no invented clean result.

completion_evidence: Failure-injection tests for each observation edge and an integration case refusing a dependent mutation on unknown drift.
rollback: Keep conservative unavailable state and expose inspect action; do not use empty-list fallback.

tasks.title: Make sandbox image identity stable and provenance-aware
tasks.behavior_change: Equal dependency/build inputs from different random staging directories can identify the same reusable image, while changed platform/builder/toolchain inputs invalidate it.
implementation_steps: Define cache-key version over dependency inputs, effective builder, actual toolchain/builder version, platform/architecture and material build options; keep repository basename cosmetic.
Supply actual observed Nixpacks version and define a deterministic fallback-builder identity/version.
Inspect required image provenance labels/digest before reuse; image existence or equal dephash alone is not a valid cache-hit proof.
Propagate the bounded reuse claim to all command/skill/README/glossary surfaces from one owning fact.
Choose non-destructive handling for old cache tags: miss/rebuild or explicit verified adoption, never unverified retagging.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Node/Python fallback where supported, offline runtime policy and source volume separation.
No automatic prune of other images merely because cache-key version changed.

acceptance: Two complete creates with identical inputs but distinct temporary checkout basenames select one verified reusable image.
Changed manifest/platform/toolchain/fallback template selects a new identity; actual cache hit skips build only after provenance passes.
rejection_and_failure: Malformed/unavailable version or missing/wrong provenance cannot masquerade as cache hit.
concurrency_and_interruption: Concurrent same-key builds converge safely without adopting partial images; cancellation leaves honest build state.

completion_evidence: Unit identity tests plus real Docker two-create cache/rebuild fixture for each supported builder path.
Docs distinguish equal key from observed reusable image.
rollback: Old images remain intact; revert key use to cache-miss behavior if necessary, not unsafe reuse.
claim_delta: Cross-create cache reuse depends on all declared material inputs and verified image provenance.

tasks.title: Treat Docker output overflow as lost observation requiring containment
tasks.behavior_change: Overflow is a distinct interrupted outcome; terminating Docker CLI observation cannot be reported as contained workload completion.
implementation_steps: Carry overflow reason and observation state in the Docker client result rather than ordinary exit 1.
Apply the same owned target-aware stop/verify policy used for timeout/cancel whenever observation is lost.
Report command result and container containment separately, retaining target ID for reconciliation if stop cannot be proven.
Keep cleanup bounded and independent from the cancelled/overflowed client signal.
existing_behavior_to_preserve: Existing explicit timeout and user-cancel behavior; named target scope; no global prune.

acceptance: Overflowing real container command is stopped/verified, or reports containment unknown with its exact target retained.
Ordinary command exit 1 without observation loss remains an ordinary command failure.

original_findings.title: Pi author child has no usable mutation authorization path
original_findings.implication: The role advertises write/edit/bash but the default execute policy asks for every mutator and the child has RPC UI. The child also lacks the approved-permission audit callback. Successful handshake/read capability therefore does not imply author capability.
original_findings.recommendation: Keep final guard fail-closed; define a parent-issued task-scoped delegated capability with explicit paths/commands, expiry/session/generation, and parent-owned durable audit. Until that contract exists, advertise this child role as read-only/unavailable for authorship.

original_findings.title: Pi ready state can outlive failed persona initialization
evidence: plugins/ca-pi/tools/src/extension.ts:session_start markReady before loadPersona and combined catch
original_findings.implication: A persona read failure is stored as bridge degradation after readiness. A later successful bridge refresh can clear that degraded state while persona remains empty, with no persona retry edge.
original_findings.recommendation: Make persona loading an explicit prerequisite or a durable independent unavailable capability. Ready/governed rendering must depend on the same actual prerequisite vector as prompt construction.

original_findings.title: Sidebar installs after disposal when metrics promise resolves late
original_findings.implication: A disposed session can reclaim terminal width and renderer hooks. The source-module probe disposed while metrics was pending, then observed installed=true and columns 140→99 after resolving metrics.
original_findings.recommendation: Apply the existing footer generation/lease pattern to sidebar installs, checking before and after await and before patching. Disposal invalidates every pending install.

original_findings.title: Qualified production artifact manifests are rejected by farm parser
original_findings.implication: Farm accepts exact top-level keys format/version/protocol/schema_version/binaries. Promotion adds context_qualification, and production cold execution requires the current platform in that field. Thus a production-qualified manifest shape fails farm admission before native binary execution. This is current-source incompatibility, not an assertion that a particular published release was observed failing.
original_findings.recommendation: Use one versioned release-manifest decoder/contract across farm, installers and verification; explicitly admit and validate the supported optional context field. Add an exact qualified-package farm admission test before loosening any trust checks.

original_findings.title: Farm receipt failure is not a safe author-redispatch instruction
original_findings.implication: Exit 3 can follow successful task commits/merges and integration worktree cleanup. A new invocation force-resets integration to base and replaces same task branches/worktrees. Reused FARM_RUN_ID also opens an existing run directory and truncates stream evidence.
original_findings.recommendation: Split recover-receipt from retry-author. Persist an exclusive run identity and durable task/integration commit references, inspect existing refs on recovery, and reproduce missing receipts without scheduling authors. Reject run-ID reuse unless an explicit recovery contract verifies it.

original_findings.title: Farm gate retry loses containment failure
original_findings.implication: The executor distinguishes timeout with verified cleanup (124) from unverified cleanup (125/cleanupFailed). runGate reduces all nonzero outcomes to ordinary gate failure, allowing outer author reset/retry; mutation path treats unverified containment as fatal.
original_findings.recommendation: Return operation result, cancellation reason and containment status as separate typed fields through every caller. Block mutation/reset/retry until prior containment is verified, reusing the mutation path policy where applicable.

original_findings.title: Farm Git observation failure can appear as no drift
original_findings.implication: Failed diff/ls-files observations are replaced with empty arrays. Both failures can yield a clean-looking drift result.
original_findings.recommendation: Use observed-clean/observed-dirty/unavailable states; retry bounded read-only Git probes if appropriate, and stop effects when absence cannot be established.

original_findings.title: Sandbox dependency cache identity is tied to random checkout basename
original_findings.implication: Two creates with identical dependency files compute the same hash but random temporary checkout names produce different Docker tags, defeating intended cross-create cache reuse. Current caller also omits the available Nixpacks version component.
original_findings.recommendation: Build a stable cache key from dependency inputs, supported platform and actual builder/toolchain version. Keep repository name only as a cosmetic label; verify existing image provenance before reuse.

original_findings.title: Sandbox output overflow kills observation client without stopping workload
original_findings.implication: Overflow is returned as ordinary exit 1 rather than a distinct interrupted reason. exec stops container only for timeout/abort; probe observed no stop after overflow.
original_findings.recommendation: Carry overflow as explicit interrupted outcome and run the same verified containment policy as other lost-observation paths. Report stop outcome independently from command failure.

original_findings.title: Sandbox cleanup and discovery sometimes claim more than observed
original_findings.implication: Claude-inside error says destroyed after an ignored rm result that may be pre-aborted; create compensation ignores remove results; registry view returns [] when Docker listing fails. destroy/prune already contains a better explicit unknown/re-observe pattern.
original_findings.recommendation: Reuse destroy/prune observation contracts for create/Claude compensation and registry UI. Keep resource IDs and cleanup unknown until an un-aborted read confirms absence. Propagate cancellation through clone/build and bound helper cleanup.

original_findings.title: Site search handles loader failure but not query/result-data failure
original_findings.implication: Pagefind module import has retry state; search/data promises do not. Rejection can preserve stale current-looking results or disable show-all indefinitely.
original_findings.recommendation: Give query and expansion their own error/retry state and finally cleanup, bound to the existing query generation token; retain input and clearly mark old results stale.

original_findings.title: Private Pi artifact prompt is not general installed Pi approval support
evidence: tools/build-host-packages.py:cold execution synthetic Pi approval evidence
original_findings.implication: Private entry requires exact Pi 1.0.2 while supported runtime compatibility is 1.1.0. It rejects ordinary agent flows; cold-package workflow reports synthetic-policy-event evidence for Pi. This cannot support a broad claim that all installed Pi artifact approvals are host-observed.
original_findings.recommendation: Publish a host/capability/evidence-mode matrix from actual admission contracts. Version private approval separately and qualify it on supported Pi before describing it as usable authority; preserve ordinary progress independent of optional attestation.

original_findings.title: Surface and release build helpers have recoverable partial-write states
original_findings.implication: Canonical generation is deterministic but many multi-file writes are not atomic; some remove old output before late render/rename failures. This is acceptable only if callers treat failed builds as unusable and rerun from canonical input.
original_findings.recommendation: Build into a complete fresh staging tree, validate there, then swap an owned output root where practical. Do not expand ordinary file tools into a distributed saga; apply durable receipts primarily to irreversible/external effects.

original_findings.title: Compatibility metadata validates a removal slogan, not release-history authorization
original_findings.implication: The literal removalRequires value is shape-checked during surface generation. It does not enforce elapsed releases, version floors, release publication status or actual command removal.
original_findings.recommendation: Keep provenance-aware removal gate separate and authoritative; generate compatibility prose from that enforceable contract instead of implying this registry literal proves removal eligibility.

original_findings.title: Claude and Codex promotion intentionally differ but share unknown-outcome recovery
original_findings.implication: Both pin immutable distribution commits, refuse same-version drift, lease channel writes and read back. Codex requires prior immutable tag before channel advance and rejects malformed current version; Claude combines tag/channel flow and skips downgrade comparison if prior version cannot be read.
original_findings.recommendation: Preserve host distribution differences. Share verified-ref outcome types and explicitly reject unknown current-channel version if monotonicity is required; provide fresh-work re-observation after any uncertain push rather than blind retry.

original_findings.title: Site drawer reconnect cleanup may duplicate local handlers
original_findings.implication: Cleanup removes document Escape handler and resets initialized marker but does not remove local opener/close/tray handlers; reconnecting the same element can bind duplicate toggles.
original_findings.recommendation: Own all listeners with one AbortController per connection, or retain the once-bound marker while reattaching document listeners. Add one connect-disconnect-reconnect behavior check only if this lifecycle is supported.
original_findings.confidence: source-confirmed; browser reconnect behavior not executed

original_findings.title: Sandbox preflight instructions refuse a dependency configuration that README and driver support

sources.symbol: targeted destroy and explicit prune; S53

original_findings.recommendation: Specify a frozen operation target set. A named destroy verifies that instance; explicit prune/no-ID selects the broad labeled set. Report other active boxes separately and never broaden cleanup merely to satisfy global-empty wording.

original_findings.status: public storage claim contradicted by audited host staging
original_findings.title: Sandbox docs omit the temporary host copy of cloned source
original_findings.claim: sandbox.md and lifecycle say cloned code is never on the host filesystem; README says the cloned repo lives inside the container. Audited S48 create copies the checkout from the source volume into a newly named host temp directory for build analysis, then removes it in finally. This contradicts storage-location wording; it does not by itself show that the runtime container has a host bind mount.
original_findings.recommendation: State runtime mount isolation separately from host-side build staging, including temp location/lifetime/cleanup observations. Keep the no-bind/socket/privileged invariants; do not claim zero host source bytes while staging is implemented.

original_findings.status: advertised transition unavailable in current ordinary runtime
original_findings.title: Ordinary sandbox allowlist selection is described as applied although its run path stays offline
original_findings.claim: Command/skill/README offer ordinary allowlist policy and lifecycle Phase 3 says richer policies are applied by network.ts. Audited S50 finds NETWORKED_POLICIES empty and all ordinary runtime containers use --network none. The standalone helper and separate Claude-inside firewall path do not establish ordinary CLI integration.
original_findings.recommendation: Expose effective policy and current availability in generated help/instructions. Preserve offline behavior; any new network capability requires its own concrete implementation/verification and policy review.

original_findings.status: additional affected documentation for existing runtime finding SF08
original_findings.title: Cache reuse promise is repeated across independent sandbox surfaces
original_findings.claim: COMMANDS glossary, README, create command and lifecycle all promise identical dependency inputs imply identical tag/cache hit. Existing SF08/S49 identifies random create checkout basenames in the actual tag, defeating that cross-create promise.
original_findings.related_finding: SF08; no additional runtime defect is asserted
original_findings.recommendation: Correct stable cache identity once in the driver, then derive the same bounded reuse claim for every surface. Keep cache-hit proof separate from hash equality.

original_findings.title: Claude-inside requires codeArbiter maintainer evidence under the consumer project root
original_findings.claim: Preflight says read or STOP for two specific sandbox spike documents and ADR 0007 at CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.codearbiter. There is no packaged-reference fallback in the skill. Therefore a consumer project without those files is directed to stop even when driver/platform requirements are otherwise satisfied; the audit does not assume a particular user project’s files.
original_findings.recommendation: Ship a concise current prerequisite/capability contract at a plugin-owned path and cite maintainer evidence as commit-bound provenance. Do not require consumers to manufacture/copy internal ADR or historical spike files.

original_findings.status: prose enforcement claim exceeds executable admission
original_findings.title: Separate executable placement does not enforce five Claude-inside workflow phases
original_findings.claim: The skill says separate binary placement IS the gate and calls the five BLOCK phases enforced rather than advice. Fully read runClaudeInsideCli accepts image/home/policy, checks environment token presence, then calls runClaudeInside; it consumes no proof of caller identity, approved store, reviewed image or phase completion. Actual token-argv/source-volume/policy and runtime isolation guards remain real and should be credited individually.
original_findings.recommendation: Label model-guided checks and mechanically enforced guards accurately. Keep the separate supported entrypoint and real isolation checks; introduce no new mandatory proof/approval mechanism unless a concrete authority design is intentionally approved.

original_findings.status: README claims compared with fully audited hook owner evidence
original_findings.title: Claude README overstates dormant behavior and confines repository writes too narrowly
original_findings.claim: README says hooks immediately do nothing without .codearbiter and repository writes are .codearbiter only. The hook owner confirms session-start.main clears its mode marker and may heal globally owned statusline settings before the active-repository check. Opted-in initialization also installs Git hooks and writes selected Git-common info/exclude and hook bookkeeping outside .codearbiter. These are different scopes and should be stated separately.
original_findings.recommendation: Document repository enforcement activation separately from host-wide startup maintenance. List Git metadata writes and existing opt-in boundaries. This requires claim correction, not removing useful maintenance or broadening authority.

prior_evidence.boundary: Prior probes are source-module/fake-dependency diagnosis; not exact installed-host or Docker qualification. Original findings remain commit-bound and their recommendations yield to explicit current user decisions.
